questions_and_answers.question_text: उनका दफ्तर साढ़े आठ बजे खुलता है ।
सफ़र में कांच के बर्तन टूट-फूट जाते हैं ।
कल रात हवा से हमारी दोनों खिड़कियां खुल गईं ।

answers.answer_text: Last night the wind opened both of our windows.

questions_and_answers.question_text: तस्वीरें फर्श पर गिरकर टूट गईं ।

answers.answer_text: The pictures fell onto the floor and broke.

questions_and_answers.question_text: हम अपने कपड़े धोबी से धुलवा लेंगे ।

answers.answer_text: We will have our clothes washed by the washerman.

answers.answer_text: The gardener will have his letter read by someone.

questions_and_answers.question_text: उसने अपना काम किस से करवाया ?

answers.answer_text: By whom did he have his work done?
